label: Green
description: Volcano is in normal, non-eruptive state.  Or, after a change from a higher alert level: Volcanic activity considered to have ceased, and volcano reverted to its normal, non-eruptive state.

label: Yellow
description: Volcano is experiencing signs of elevated unrest above known background levels. Or, after a change from higher alert level: Volcanic activity has decreased significantly but continues to be closely monitored for possible renewed increase.

label: Orange
description: Volcano is exhibiting heightened unrest with increased likelihood of eruption.  Or, volcanic eruption is underway with no or minor ash emission [specify ash-plume height if possible].

label: Red
description: Eruption is forecasted to be imminent with significant emission of ash into the atmosphere likely. Or, eruption is underway with significant emission of ash into the atmosphere [specify ash-plume height if possible].
